quarterly_data.signal: Pacific Biosciences' 10-Q: remaining performance obligations were $47.9 million as of June 30, 2026, approximately 79% expected to convert to revenue over the next twelve months and approximately 17% in the following twelve months.
quarterly_data.figure: remaining performance obligations $47.9 million (June 30, 2026); ~79% next twelve months; ~17% following twelve months

quarterly_data.signal: Pacific Biosciences' 10-Q: cost of product revenue rose $0.9 million (5%) in Q2 2026, primarily from exit costs associated with a contract manufacturer, increased memory costs, product transition costs tied to the short-read asset disposition and amortization of the patent license from the PGI settlement. PacBio says that, due in part to accelerated demand associated with data processing and storage applications, it has experienced and may continue to experience inflationary pressure on certain components, including semiconductor materials such as memory chips.
quarterly_data.figure: cost of product revenue +$0.9 million (5%) in Q2 2026
